title_zh: FREE-LIVO：物理解耦但紧耦合的 LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计
dek: FREE-LIVO 不要求 LiDAR–相机刚性外参或时间同步：它把单帧 LiDAR 强度图经 Conditional Rectified Flow 上采样，与 RGB 图像做 SuperPoint/LightGlue 匹配，构造跨模态重投影因子，并把 LiDAR、视觉、IMU 约束放进同一因子图。M3DGR 六序列平均 ATE 0.45 m；解耦机器人实验是定性结果，不等于所有环境定位优势。
scope: AI 辅助历史补读 · 待核验。本次由 DeepSeek 子代理读取 arXiv v1 HTML 正文、图注、表格及可提取公式后整理，并实际查看所展示原图；不是独立 DeepSeek API 账单任务，不计入其用量。本子代理已按 Skill 自查证据、公式、原图与页面；主会话仅核查提交与完成状态，文章仍待人工抽查。本次重点核对：物理解耦（无刚性外参/时间同步）与紧耦合（同一因子图原始观测）的区别；M3DGR 定量结果与 FAST-LIVO2/自采/两机实验的定性边界；时间延迟结果按户外/动态分组读，不合并为统一保证。未运行作者程序、未独立复现实验，也未经过人工审稿。

paragraphs.heading: 系统与核心主张
paragraphs.text: FREE-LIVO 是面向模块化/异构机器人的紧耦合 LIVO：不要求 LiDAR–相机刚性支架或时间同步；用预训练图像匹配器把相机图像与单帧 LiDAR 经生成模型上采样得到的稠密强度图匹配，由三维点—像素对应构造重投影因子，再与点云配准、视觉跟踪及各传感器 IMU 约束放进同一因子图。

evidence.quote: this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR–camera rig nor LiDAR–camera time synchronization.

The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model.
the proposed system is based on a tight coupling of LiDAR, camera, and IMU constraints, meaning that the raw observations from these sensors are fused in a single factor graph.

paragraphs.heading: 物理解耦与紧耦合的实际含义
paragraphs.text: 物理解耦指 LiDAR 与相机不要求刚性固定、外参或时间同步；紧耦合指原始 LiDAR、视觉、IMU 约束与跨模态重投影因子在同一因子图联合优化，而不是各自算里程计再融合位姿。它仍使用相机内参和每路 IMU 观测，也没有声称完全不需要任何标定。

evidence.quote: While the system allows the LiDAR and camera to be physically decoupled and unsynchronized, the proposed system is based on a tight coupling of LiDAR, camera, and IMU constraints
This enables operation without accurate LiDAR–camera extrinsic calibration and even with only software-level time synchronization
even when they have different timestamps, and one pose can have multiple matches.
the method does not need to include a fixed LiDAR–camera relative pose or a constant time offset as a state.

paragraphs.heading: 现有 LIVO 的刚性与同步假设
paragraphs.text: 作者把缺口放在现有 LIVO 的共同假设：LiDAR、相机、IMU 刚性安装、外参已知且时间同步；外参或时间误差会让 LiDAR 点与图像像素错位，削弱跨模态约束。R3LIVE 虽估计相对位姿与时间偏移，但假设二者保持不变。

evidence.quote: most existing LIVO systems assume that the LiDAR, camera, and IMU are rigidly mounted on a common platform with known extrinsic parameters and accurate time synchronization.
Even small errors in these parameters can misalign LiDAR measurements and image pixels, weakening the cross-modal constraints and degrading state estimation accuracy
R3LIVE [ 15 ] estimates the relative pose and time offset between the LiDAR and camera but assumes that both remain constant.

paragraphs.heading: 模块化与异构机器人的需求
paragraphs.text: 模块化/异构系统中，传感器可以装在独立运动的执行器、移动传感单元甚至不同机器人上；LiDAR–相机相对位姿随时间变化，严格同步也可能不可得，传统 LIVO 的假设失效。

evidence.quote: As robotic systems become increasingly modular and heterogeneous, sensors can instead be mounted on independently moving actuators or mobile sensing units, or even distributed across separate robots.
allowing the LiDAR and camera to be placed and moved independently, including on separate robots.

paragraphs.heading: 本文的回应与边界
paragraphs.text: 已有跨模态 LiDAR–视觉匹配多用于全局定位/地点识别，比较全局特征来检索地点，不做连续的点/像素级位姿估计；本文把细粒度对应放进因子图，用重投影因子连续连接两条传感器轨迹。它证明的是这类对应可用于里程计，不是所有跨模态匹配器都能直接替换。

evidence.quote: These methods compare global features from images and point clouds to retrieve corresponding places or detect loop closure candidates.
In contrast, our method finds fine-grained correspondences between individual LiDAR and camera features and estimates the LiDAR and camera poses through factor graph optimization
uses the correspondences obtained from Tabata et al. [ 5 ] in a tightly coupled LIVO system.

paragraphs.heading: 观测链：LiDAR 强度上采样与跨模态匹配
paragraphs.text: 观测链是：LiDAR 扫描下采样/去畸变，投影成稀疏强度图，经 Conditional Rectified Flow 上采样为稠密强度图，再用 SuperPoint 与 LightGlue（MINIMA 权重）与 RGB 图像匹配；由匹配像素和 LiDAR 深度得到三维点—像素对应。相机侧用光流/KLT 跟踪特征，LiDAR 与相机各自使用 IMU 预积分。

evidence.quote: then upsamples it to a dense LiDAR intensity image
using a pretrained feature matcher
we employ SuperPoint [ 30 ] and LightGlue [ 31 ] to balance matching accuracy and computational efficiency.
we use the MINIMA weights [ 32 ] , which were fine-tuned for multi-modal matching.

paragraphs.heading: 因子图结构：三条约束链
paragraphs.text: 因子图分三部分：标准 LiDAR–IMU 里程计（点云配准加 IMU 预积分）、视觉–IMU 里程计（smart visual factors 加 IMU）、以及连接两者的 LiDAR–相机重投影因子；两条状态序列独立创建，跨模态因子可连接不同时间戳的位姿，因此不需要固定相对外参或常数时间偏移状态。

evidence.quote: The factor graph consists of three parts: one for standard LiDAR–IMU odometry, one for visual–IMU odometry, and one connecting the two.
The LiDAR and camera state sequences are created independently, but they are connected by LiDAR–camera reprojection factors based on the correspondences
Therefore, the method does not need to include a fixed LiDAR–camera relative pose or a constant time offset as a state.

paragraphs.heading: 重投影因子与鲁棒核
paragraphs.text: 对每个对应，用相机位姿的逆乘 LiDAR 位姿得到相对变换，把三维点投影到像素，与观测像素相减得到重投影误差；逐对应用 Huber，整对帧用 DCS 降权，以同时处理单点错配和整帧错配。

evidence.quote: the relative transformation from L at scan i to C at image j
The reprojection error is defined as the difference between the projected pixel and the observed pixel
we apply the Huber loss to each correspondence to reduce the effect of a small number of incorrect matches.
We also apply Dynamic Covariance Scaling (DCS) [ 41 ] to all correspondences in each LiDAR–camera frame pair.

paragraphs.heading: 联合优化与实现
paragraphs.text: 完整目标把先验、LiDAR、视觉、IMU 与 LiDAR–相机重投影误差一起优化；用 iSAM2/GTSAM 增量求解，固定滞后窗 5 秒并边缘化窗外观测。实现在 AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS、RTX 4080、32 GB 上运行，生成模型与特征匹配用 TensorRT 半精度；匹配置信度低于 0.01 丢弃，至少 50 个有效对应才加因子。

evidence.quote: We solve Eq. ( 4 ) incrementally using iSAM2 [ 42 ] implemented in GTSAM [ 43 ] .
we use fixed-lag smoothing with a 5-second window and marginalize states that leave the window.
the system runs in real time on a laptop with an AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS CPU, an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 GPU, and 32 GB of memory.
Matches with a LightGlue confidence score below 0.01 are removed, and a LiDAR–camera reprojection factor is added only when at least 50 valid 2D–3D correspondences remain.

paragraphs.heading: 生成式上采样的一步
paragraphs.text: 上采样式是 Euler 积分：当前图像状态 X_k 加上速度场 V_θ 在条件稀疏强度图与时间 t_k 下预测的速度乘步长 Δt，得到下一步状态；θ 是网络参数。它把稀疏强度图变成稠密图供特征匹配，不是物理传播模型，也没有给出不确定度。

evidence.quote: We use Conditional Rectified Flow [ 26 ] to generate the dense intensity image
Conditional Rectified Flow represents the process from Gaussian noise to the dense intensity image
We integrate the predicted velocity over time with the Euler method at each generation step to generate the dense intensity image
we train the network in two stages: pretraining and fine-tuning.

paragraphs.heading: 因子图目标与未建模项
paragraphs.text: 总目标是先验、LiDAR、视觉、IMU 与跨模态重投影误差的加权和；Huber/DCS 只降低异常权重，不保证错配被识别。论文没有为学习到的匹配给出闭式协方差，也没有把固定外参或时间偏移作为状态；因此“不需要同步”是方法设计，不是对所有错配的鲁棒性证明。

evidence.quote: all LiDAR and camera poses, velocities, and IMU biases in the current optimization window
Thus, all constraints from the LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements and the LiDAR–camera matches are optimized together in one tightly coupled factor graph.
If many correspondences are incorrect, DCS smoothly reduces the weight of the whole factor.

paragraphs.heading: 数据与基线
paragraphs.text: 定量评估用 M3DGR 六条序列；FAST-LIVO2 数据集和自采数据无地面真值，只做定性。基线包括 GLIM、VINS-Mono、LVI-SAM、R3LIVE、FAST-LIVO2；基线使用数据集提供的外参与时间同步，FREE-LIVO 不使用显式外参。

evidence.quote: We use the M3DGR dataset [ 44 ] , the FAST-LIVO2 dataset [ 14 ] , and an in-house dataset for evaluation.
The FAST-LIVO2 dataset and in-house dataset do not provide ground truth and are therefore used only for qualitative evaluation.
GLIM [ 9 ] as the LIO, VINS-Mono [ 10 ] as the VIO, and LVI-SAM [ 13 ] , R3LIVE [ 15 ] , and FAST-LIVO2 [ 14 ] as the LIVO baselines.

The LIVO baselines use the LiDAR–camera extrinsic parameters and time synchronization provided by each dataset. The M3DGR dataset uses software-level rather than strict hardware time synchronization, which poses challenges for accurate LiDAR–camera fusion. We evaluate the proposed method without explicit LiDAR–camera extrinsic parameters.

paragraphs.heading: 评价协议
paragraphs.text: 轨迹精度用 evo 计算平移 ATE 的 RMSE，先做 SE(3) 对齐；基线在 M3DGR 上用软件级时间同步，FREE-LIVO 不加显式 LiDAR–相机外参。这个协议比较的是给定数据与对齐方式下的轨迹误差，不是原始传感器误差或在线标定误差。

evidence.quote: We evaluate trajectory accuracy using the evo toolkit and report the root mean square error (RMSE) of the translational absolute trajectory error (ATE) after SE(3) alignment with the ground-truth trajectory.
The M3DGR dataset uses software-level rather than strict hardware time synchronization, which poses challenges for accurate LiDAR–camera fusion.

paragraphs.heading: 时间同步压力测试
paragraphs.text: 时间同步实验给相机数据加 0.1、0.3、0.5 s 延迟，比较 LVI-SAM、R3LIVE、FAST-LIVO2 与 FREE-LIVO；M3DGR 上报告 ATE，FAST-LIVO2 数据集上定性比较彩色点云。这个设置只改变相机时间戳，不改变 LiDAR/IMU 或外参。

evidence.quote: we add delays of 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 s to the camera data and compare LVI-SAM, R3LIVE, FAST-LIVO2, and the proposed method.
Fig. 7 qualitatively compares colored point clouds generated using the estimated trajectories on the FAST-LIVO2 dataset.

paragraphs.heading: 物理解耦实验
paragraphs.text: 物理解耦实验有两类：LiDAR 与相机分别拿在两只手上，以及分别装在 rover 与 legged robot 上独立运动；作者展示联合估计的两条轨迹与彩色点云。两类都没有绝对地面真值，属于定性可行性，不是精度基准。

evidence.quote: We evaluate FREE-LIVO using data collected with the LiDAR and camera held in separate hands
The LiDAR and camera are mounted on a rover and a legged robot, and FREE-LIVO runs in real time on a laptop carried by the rover.

paragraphs.heading: M3DGR 平均精度
paragraphs.text: 六条 M3DGR 序列上 FREE-LIVO 平均 ATE 0.45 m，GLIM 0.71 m；Outdoor01/04 为 0.18/0.40 m，Dynamic03/04 为 0.25/0.32 m；FAST-LIVO2 在 Dynamic01/02 失败。不同序列的场景与运动不同，不能把平均 0.45 m 当作每个序列的上界。

evidence.quote: Across the six sequences, the average errors of GLIM and the proposed method are 0.71 m and 0.45 m, respectively.
FAST-LIVO2 fails on these sequences, as indicated by the dagger symbols.
We use the M3DGR dataset [ 44 ] , the FAST-LIVO2 dataset [ 14 ] , and an in-house dataset for evaluation.

paragraphs.heading: 时间同步结果
paragraphs.text: 加 0.1–0.5 s 相机延迟后，户外组 ATE 保持 0.24–0.29 m，动态组从 0.77 升到 1.83 m；LVI-SAM 明显退化，R3LIVE/FAST-LIVO2 随延迟无一致趋势；0.3 s 时 FREE-LIVO 的彩色点云仍与几何对齐。“最小退化”只在户外组成立，动态组仍随时延上升。

evidence.quote: we add delays of 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 s to the camera data and compare LVI-SAM, R3LIVE, FAST-LIVO2, and the proposed method.
the proposed method maintains the correspondence between the camera image and LiDAR point cloud and generates a well-aligned colored point cloud even with a 0.3 s offset.

paragraphs.heading: 消融
paragraphs.text: 消融：完整 FREE-LIVO 平均 0.45 m，Loose（LIO/VIO 分开优化再用重投影因子连接）2.10 m，NN（用最近邻替代生成式上采样）0.52 m；Loose 在所有户外序列都更差，NN 的生成式增益在该数据集上不大。这个消融支持同一因子图与上采样的相对贡献，但不是所有场景的因果证明。

evidence.quote: the average ATE over the six sequences is 0.45 m for FREE-LIVO, 2.10 m for FREE-LIVO (Loose), and 0.52 m for FREE-LIVO (NN).
FREE-LIVO (Loose) is less accurate than the proposed method on all outdoor sequences

paragraphs.heading: 结果边界
paragraphs.text: 定量结论只来自六条有真值的公开序列；FAST-LIVO2/自采数据和两机解耦实验没有地面真值，只能看轨迹连续性与彩色点云对齐。不同数据集、序列和消融条件不能混成一个统一排名；论文也没有给出黑暗、低纹理、强光照或动态遮挡下的系统实验。

evidence.quote: The FAST-LIVO2 dataset and in-house dataset do not provide ground truth and are therefore used only for qualitative evaluation.
We evaluate FREE-LIVO using data collected with the LiDAR and camera held in separate hands
The results show that both trajectories can be estimated despite continuous changes in the relative pose between the sensors and different vibration characteristics of the two robots.
we add delays of 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 s to the camera data

paragraphs.heading: 范围与数据
paragraphs.text: 范围是 M3DGR 六条序列的定量轨迹误差，加上 FAST-LIVO2/自采数据的定性展示；基线使用数据集提供的外参与同步，回环关闭；没有覆盖长期多会话、多机器人 SLAM。

evidence.quote: In the M3DGR dataset, Outdoor01, Outdoor04, Dynamic03, and Dynamic04 are outdoor sequences, whereas Dynamic01 and Dynamic02 are indoor sequences.
Although GLIM, VINS-Mono, and LVI-SAM provide loop closure, we disable it
report the root mean square error (RMSE) of the translational absolute trajectory error (ATE) after SE(3) alignment
The FAST-LIVO2 dataset and in-house dataset do not provide ground truth and are therefore used only for qualitative evaluation.

paragraphs.heading: 假设与失效边界
paragraphs.text: 动态组在 0.5 s 延迟下 ATE 从 0.77 升到 1.83 m，说明“不要求同步”不等于对任意延迟无感；Loose 与 NN 消融显示因子图结构和上采样都有贡献，但生成式上采样仍可能产生伪结构；VIO 在黑暗、低纹理、光照变化或运动模糊下可能失效，本文没有系统覆盖这些条件；两机实验无真值。

evidence.quote: VIO can become unstable in dark or low-texture environments, under lighting changes, or during motion blur.
The results show that both trajectories can be estimated despite continuous changes in the relative pose between the sensors and different vibration characteristics of the two robots.
we add delays of 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 s to the camera data

paragraphs.heading: 代码、数据与复现入口
paragraphs.text: 本次读取的正文没有给出作者代码仓库或可复现脚本；M3DGR 与 FAST-LIVO2 数据集为公开数据，自采数据未说明发布方式。因此代码入口与自采数据获取记为 unknown，不能声称复现其 ATE。

paragraphs.heading: 建立跨模态匹配的误差—延迟基准
paragraphs.text: 建议在公开数据上建立跨模态匹配基准：同一 LiDAR/相机序列分别注入 0、0.1、0.3、0.5 s 时间偏移和外参扰动，报告匹配内点率、重投影误差、ATE、每帧延迟与失败帧；把生成式上采样、最近邻上采样和不同匹配器作为消融。只有匹配质量与轨迹误差同时可复现，才能判断解耦方案的适用边界。

paragraphs.heading: 把两机解耦实验做成有真值的多机器人 SLAM
paragraphs.text: 第二个实验是给 rover 与 legged robot 的两条轨迹提供独立真值（动作捕捉或 RTK），测试相对位姿连续变化、不同振动、短时遮挡和通信延迟下的联合估计；交付两条轨迹的 ATE、相对位姿误差、重投影内点率、时间偏移估计误差与失败模式。这能把当前的定性可行性升级为可比较的多机器人 SLAM 证据。

equations.title: Conditional Rectified Flow 的一步 Euler 上采样
equations.meaning: 当前图像状态 X_k 加上速度场 V_θ 在稀疏强度图与时间 t_k 条件下预测的速度乘步长 Δt，得到下一步状态；θ 是网络参数。
equations.caution: 这是生成模型的数值积分，不是物理传播方程；它没有给出密度估计的不确定度。上采样质量依赖训练数据与条件强度图，伪结构可能进入后续匹配。

reading_steps.title: 先看 (a) 的传感器状态
reading_steps.text: 相机与 LiDAR 没有刚性连接，且未同步；这是方法要处理的物理条件，不是实验误差。

reading_steps.title: 再看 (b) 的彩色点云
reading_steps.text: 颜色来自相机图像，几何来自 LiDAR；颜色与物体边界对齐说明重投影因子把两路观测关联起来。

reading_steps.title: 最后看 (c) 的两条轨迹
reading_steps.text: 绿、蓝是分别估计的 LiDAR/相机轨迹，灰线是跨模态重投影因子；两条轨迹不是同一条刚体轨迹。

original_figures.caption: Fig. 2: Overview of FREE-LIVO. Upsampled LiDAR intensity images are matched with camera images to obtain 2D–3D correspondences. These are integrated with LiDAR, visual, and IMU constraints in a single factor graph to jointly estimate sensor trajectories without a fixed LiDAR–camera rig or time synchronization.
original_figures.title: FREE-LIVO 的观测链与因子图入口
original_figures.alt: 流程图：LiDAR Point Cloud 与 IMU 经 Preprocess 得到稀疏强度图与 LiDAR 深度；LiDAR Intensity Image Upsampling（Conditional Rectified Flow）得到稠密强度图；LiDAR-Visual Feature Matching（SuperPoint + LightGlue (MINIMA)）输出 LiDAR-to-Camera 3D-2D 对应。Camera RGB 与 IMU 经 Preprocess 得到 RGB 图像；Camera-to-Camera 2D-2D 对应。另一路为 LiDAR-to-LiDAR 3D-3D 对应。所有对应进入 Sliding Window Factor Graph Optimization，右侧注明 No requirement for Fixed LiDAR-camera transformation 与 LiDAR-camera time synchronization。
original_figures.caution: 流程图不给出匹配成功率、延迟或精度；生成式上采样和特征匹配都可能失败。No requirement 指不需要固定外参与时间同步，但仍需要相机内参、每路 IMU 和可匹配的纹理/强度结构。

reading_steps.title: 先看两路输入
reading_steps.text: LiDAR 支路保留几何与强度，相机支路保留外观；两路各自有 IMU 预处理，说明它们可以是独立运动的传感器单元。

reading_steps.title: 再看跨模态匹配
reading_steps.text: 稀疏强度图先经生成模型变稠密，再与 RGB 匹配；得到的是 LiDAR-to-Camera 3D-2D 对应，不是全局描述子检索。

reading_steps.title: 最后看因子图入口
reading_steps.text: 三类对应（LiDAR-LiDAR、Camera-Camera、LiDAR-Camera）一起进入滑窗优化；右侧两条 No requirement 是设计目标，不是已证明的普适性质。

original_figures.caption: Fig. 5: Factor graph during operation. LiDAR–camera reprojection factors connect the LiDAR and camera trajectories. The colored point clouds show the reprojection points used by these factors.
original_figures.title: 运行中的因子图：两条轨迹与跨模态重投影因子
original_figures.alt: 左侧为 Reprojection Points 的彩色点集；右侧上方标 Optimization Window (5s)，绿线为 LiDAR 轨迹、蓝线为 Camera 轨迹、黄线为 LiDAR-camera reprojection factor、灰线为已被边缘化的同因子；右侧下方为 Camera-LiDAR Matching 图像，绿线把图像特征与点云对应连起来；底部图例重复四种线色。
original_figures.caution: 这是运行中的示意截图，不是全量因子图；5 s 窗口是作者设置，不是普适最优。图没有给出内点率、重投影误差分布或 ATE，不能据此判断匹配质量或定位精度。

reading_steps.title: 先看两条轨迹
reading_steps.text: 绿色 LiDAR 与蓝色 Camera 是两条独立状态序列，不是一条刚体轨迹；这正是物理解耦的表示。

reading_steps.title: 再看跨模态因子
reading_steps.text: 黄线连接当前窗口内的 LiDAR/相机位姿，灰线表示已边缘化的因子；优化窗口标为 5 s。

reading_steps.title: 最后看匹配图像
reading_steps.text: 绿色连线是实际用于重投影的对应；线越密表示该帧参与约束的匹配越多，但不代表匹配都正确。
